## Installation and setup

```{r}
#| label: install

devtools::install_github("role-model/roleR")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup

# load package as normal
library(roleR)

# only once after initial installation, we need to install python
# package `msprime` and its dependencies
installMsprime()
```



## Quick start

```{r}

# set-up parameters
p <- roleParams(
    individuals_local = 1000,
    individuals_meta = 100000,
    species_meta = 200,
    speciation_local = 1e-05,
    speciation_meta = 0.100,
    extinction_meta = 0.090,
    trait_sigma = 2,
    env_sigma = 1,
    comp_sigma = 1,
    dispersal_prob = 0.05,
    mutation_rate = 1e-09,
    neut_delta = 1,
    env_comp_delta = 0,
    equilib_escape = 1,
    alpha = 5e+03,
    num_basepairs = 300,
    init_type = "oceanic_island",
    niter = 1000000,
    niterTimestep = 500000
)

# initialize the model
m <- roleModel(p)

# run the model
r <- runRole(m)
r@info

boo <- getLocalComm(r)

ii <- order(boo@indSpecies)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 0, 0))
plot(boo@indSpecies[ii], seq(0, 1, length.out = length(boo@indSpecies)))
image(as(boo@genoMat, "matrix")[, ii], axes = FALSE)

boo@spGenDiv[!is.na(boo@spGenDiv)]
mean(as.matrix(boo@genoMat))




# par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = rep(0, 4))

pdf("~/Desktop/foo.pdf", width = 20, height = 80)
roleTre <- strsplit(rawSeqs(r), "") |> 
    setNames(paste0("sp_", boo@indSpecies)) |> 
    as.DNAbin() |>
    dist.dna(model = "JC69") |> 
# foo <- vegan::metaMDS(roleTre, k = 2, autotransform = FALSE)
# plot(foo, type = "t")
    njs() #|> 
    # unroot()
plot(roleTre)
# plot(roleTre, type = "unrooted")
tiplabels(col = as.factor(roleTre$tip.label), pch = 16)
dev.off()

x <- boo@spGenDiv
plot(sort(x[x > 0], TRUE))

tre <- getPhylo(r) |> 
    as("phylo")


drop.tip(tre, which(!(tre$tip.label %in% paste0("t", boo@indSpecies)))) |> 
    unroot() |> 
    plot(type = "unrooted")

boo@genoMat

t0 <- getPhylo(r, 1) |> as("phylo")
tt <- getPhylo(r) |> as("phylo")

plot(t0); axis(1)
plot(tt); axis(1)

(ape::node.depth.edgelength(t0) |> max()) - 
    (ape::node.depth.edgelength(tt) |> max())




# get results
getSumStats(r)
```
